description: Apples-to-apples multi-lender ranking by TOTAL cost of a loan (upfront origination/lender fees + lifetime interest over the holding period), not just the headline rate. Re-ranks real credit union offers and flags when the lowest-rate lender is not the cheapest overall.

holding_period_months.description: Horizon for total-cost; defaults to term_months

name: compare_total_cost

amount.description: Loan amount in dollars used for every lender in the comparison.

cheapest.description: The lender with the lowest total cost over the holding period.

total_cost.description: That lender's total cost in dollars over the holding period.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

holding_period_months.description: How long the borrower is assumed to keep the loan. Total cost is measured over this period, not the full term, so a shorter hold favors low-fee lenders.

intent.description: Borrowing purpose the pricing assumes, e.g. 'purchase' or 'refinance'.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools, as bare tool names.

note.description: Plain-English interpretation of the numbers above, already phrased for the user; quote it rather than re-deriving the comparison.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

ranked.description: Lenders ordered cheapest-first by total cost over the holding period.

apr.description: APR in percent, including fees where published.

headline_rank.description: Where this lender would rank on headline APR alone; compare with `rank` to see when fees change the winner.

interest_over_holding.description: Interest in dollars paid over the holding period only, not the full term.

monthly_payment.description: Principal-and-interest payment in dollars per month; excludes taxes, insurance, PMI, and HOA.

principal_paid_over_holding.description: Principal in dollars retired over the holding period; this is equity built, not a cost.

rank.description: Position by total cost over the holding period, 1 = cheapest.

rate.description: Note rate in percent, excluding fees.

remaining_balance.description: Loan balance in dollars still owed at the end of the holding period.

total_cost.description: Upfront fees plus interest over the holding period, in dollars — the ranking metric. It excludes principal, which is not a cost.

total_cost_vs_best.description: Dollars more expensive than the cheapest lender over the holding period. 0 marks the winner.

upfront_fees.description: Origination and lender fees in dollars paid at closing, as modeled from the caller's fee assumptions.

ranked_by.description: The metric the list is sorted by — 'total_cost' means cheapest over the holding period, which can differ from the lowest rate.

rate_leader.description: The lender with the lowest headline APR, which is not always the cheapest overall.

reranked.description: True when accounting for fees changed the winner from the headline rate leader — the key finding to surface when it is true.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (360 = 30 years, 180 = 15 years, 60 = 5 years).
